rules.action: Opens the list (if closed) and moves the active option down; focus stays in the input.
Opens the list and moves the active option up.
Commits the active option (single: closes; multiple: toggles and stays open); with allowCustom and no active option, commits the typed text.
Closes the list if open; if closed and clearable, clears the input text.
Closes the list and moves focus on. Under single-select a highlighted option is NOT committed by Tab (typing intent is ambiguous).
In an empty input with chips, removes the last chip.
Move the text caret (input semantics), never the list.
With allowCustom, commits the typed text as a custom value (as Enter does) and clears the input.
Opens the list without moving the active option.
